verdict.rationale: gstack ships a dedicated /gstack-upgrade skill. It detects whether the install is global or vendored, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new, so users get fixes without reinstalling. Its docs also reference an opt-in auto-upgrade setting (GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE). missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that upgrades work cleanly, and detailed docs on how auto-upgrade behaves (frequency, rollback, version pinning).

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: Detects global vs vendored install, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new.
